Exact Fraction checks show initial9/10 and1/2; modified9/11 and1/2; equal-size6/6,3/6 yields3/4; two hypothetical models can have total9/10 but macro1/2 versus9/10. Overlapping groups [correct a,wrong b] and[correct a,wrong c] give duplicated2/4 versus unique1/3. For iid n=k=1,95% Clopper-Pearson lower p solves P(X>=1)=p=0.025, upper1.
